title: MangoHub
features:
MangoHub is a script designed specifically for use in Brookhaven. For now, MangoHub is exclusive to Brookhaven, but we’re working on expanding the code to support other Roblox games. MangoHub is a powerful script packed with fun and exciting features. Here are just a few of them:

[1] Kill players, bring them to you, or send them into the void.  
[2] Crash or lag the server.  
[3] Features like making parts of the map explode (among many others).  
[4] Duplicate objects and create shapes with them.

There are many more features! If you’re interested in the script, you can join our Discord:  

--> https://discord.gg/WuNdeVuyVz

About MangoHub:

The script uses a key system with two checkpoints, and the key lasts for 48 hours.  

It features a clean, minimalist GUI that’s easy to navigate and understand.  

If you have any questions or issues, you can open a ticket on our Discord, and we’ll be happy to help!
